# Security Checklist: G56R-001 Candidate Route Baseline

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for role safety boundaries, mutation scope, sandbox and approval evidence, tool/skill/MCP contracts, and source authority.
**Created**: 2026-07-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests requirements quality, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are safety, grounding, mutation, tool, skill, MCP, source-config, output, and client-surface contracts required for every role? [Completeness, Spec FR-008]
- [x] CHK002 Are declared TOML sandbox and mutation fields separated from effective runtime permissions and parent overrides? [Completeness, Spec Role Contract Record Shape]
- [x] CHK003 Are effective runtime permissions, sandbox, approval policy, parent overrides, loaded tools, loaded skills, and MCP state deferred to later verification? [Completeness, Spec Role Contract Record Shape]
- [x] CHK004 Are parity-only Claude roles prevented from establishing active Codex platform behavior? [Completeness, Spec FR-009]
- [x] CHK005 Are installer, payload, cache, generated artifact, version, and agent-definition mutations explicitly out of scope? [Completeness, Spec FR-002, Plan Constraints]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the role boundary required to include in-scope actions, out-of-scope actions, and a representative future task? [Clarity, Spec Role Contract Record Shape]
- [x] CHK007 Are tool, skill, and MCP needs required as separate contracts rather than one combined capability field? [Clarity, Spec FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 Is the exact-treatment boundary clear enough to prevent a later route from weakening safety or mutation constraints? [Clarity, Spec Role Contract Record Shape]
- [x] CHK009 Are project-input trust boundaries clearly separated from official platform authority? [Clarity, Spec FR-004, FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do candidate records require role-contract binding before any route can be admitted for discovery? [Consistency, Spec FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 Do the spec and plan consistently prohibit runtime behavior, installation, route policy, and fallback changes? [Consistency, Spec FR-002, Plan Constraints]
- [x] CHK012 Do fixture telemetry requirements preserve sandbox, approvals, tools, skills, MCP, and parent-child attribution as future evidence needs? [Consistency, Spec Fixture Backlog Record Shape]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can reviewers objectively determine whether parity roles are comparison inputs only? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec FR-009]
- [x] CHK015 Can reviewers objectively determine whether candidate admission preserves hard role contracts instead of weakening them? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec FR-011, SC-003]
